name: dbdatabuild
description: Work in a dbdatabuild project: validate, lineage, plans, sample data and table diff, as tools for an agent and as an app in the conversation. Read-only: nothing is applied to a database from this bundle.
long_description: dbdatabuild builds analytics tables and views on SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Fabric from SQL written in DuckDB's dialect, plan then apply. This bundle runs `dbdatabuild ui mcp` on the project folder you choose: the commands that do not change a database are tools, the skill and the JSON Schemas are resources, and on hosts that support MCP Apps the web interface opens in the conversation. It starts without --allow-writes and --allow-apply; to apply plans from a host, configure the server by hand (docs/interfaces.md).

project.title: Project folder
project.description: The dbdatabuild project to work on (the folder with dbdatabuild.yml).
